title: Senior Lecturer of Business Administration
bio: When to take a sabbatical—and how to avoid waiting for a crisis to take off. Why sabbaticals—unlike vacations—help you forge a new career path, feel human again, and live a more authentic life. How to navigate your sabbatical using archetypes—the explorer, the seeker, and the achiever—and avoid common pitfalls. Best practices for individuals—no matter the circumstances—and organizations of all sizes to make extended leave possible and sustainable.
